notes: A weave.erased placeholder has no sigs; records[0].digest is the §2.2 digest over the placeholder, records[0].verdict is 'erased', its attestation reference resolves to 'missing' (reported in the separate attestation object, refs stays empty) and the top-level verdict is 'erased'. The standalone placeholder pins L_ERASED_PLACEHOLDER and L_ERASED_STANDALONE (T12).
